novelty_basis: Connected Cartesian primes = OEIS A129582 (Ji Li, Prime graphs and exponential composition of species, J. Combin. Theory A 115 (2008) 1374-1401, arXiv:0705.0038). The semiring view of disconnected graphs and the parallel cancellation theory for Cartesian and strong products are in Hammack-Imrich-Klavzar's Handbook and Klavzar et al., Cancellation properties of products of graphs; the isomorphism statement is a reformulation.

statement:
There is an order-preserving monoid isomorphism between (finite graphs, Cartesian product) and (finite graphs,
strong product), and by complementation between the co-normal product and code 221; for every n the four
products have the same number of prime graphs of order n, and the connected Cartesian and strong primes are
equinumerous (OEIS A129582).
title: The Cartesian and strong product monoids of all finite graphs are isomorphic graded monoids; equal prime counts (A129582)
